name: HCLTech
lede: HCLTech is reorganising around industry verticals and moving toward outcome-based models as it builds out its AI business. Airtable connects the teams and programs behind that shift.
why_p: A new vertical structure, record bookings and the push to decouple growth from headcount all raise the bar for how programs are coordinated.

signals.title: CEO on decoupling growth from headcount
signals.body: C Vijayakumar wrote that AI has broken the long link between staffing and revenue in IT services.
signals.angle: Productivity gains depend on connected workflows that let existing teams do more.

signals.title: Largest leadership reorganisation in three years
signals.body: HCLTech moved parts of its geography-led structure to sector-focused businesses to deepen industry expertise as AI reshapes demand.
signals.angle: Give newly formed verticals a shared way to run programs instead of each building its own tooling.

signals.title: Record Q1 bookings and AI data centre plans
signals.body: HCLTech reported record Q1 net new bookings of $2.4bn, Advanced AI revenue up 62.1%, and plans to invest up to INR 3,500 crore in AI data centres.
signals.angle: Track large deal delivery and build-out programs in one connected system with clear accountability.
